title: IBM i 7.3 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 is vulnerable to a stack buffer overflow, caused by improper bounds… (CVE-2026-115501)
description: IBM i versions 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in the QFileSvr.400 file system due to improper bounds checking. A local authenticated attacker could exploit this by sending a crafted command to cause undefined behavior.
